family.description: This entry represents the helical membrane plugin (HMP) domain found in a group of uncharacterised prokaryotic proteins, including the [NiFe]-hydrogenase Huc from Mycobacterium smegmatis [[cite:PUB00161758]]. It is involved in the construction of oxidoreductases in prokaryotes, which allows quinone channelling between the membrane and various redox catalytic subunits [[cite:PUB00161759]]. It was previously known as DUF1641.
family.name: Helical membrane plugin
